judgment.reason: Evidence shows FY2022 Adjusted EBITDAR of $957,307k and interest expense $594,954k (twelve months ended Dec 31 2022); Adjusted EBIT can be derived as Adjusted EBITDAR minus rent ($1,950,566k) = negative ~$993M, so reference says coverage is zero. Candidate refused claiming Adjusted EBIT not in evidence, but evidence contains sufficient data to derive it; refusal is thus wrong/substantively incorrect.
